info.title: STI Vio-Log API
info.description: Stable opaque-cookie and CSRF contract. Roles: DISCIPLINE_ADMIN, DISCIPLINE_OFFICE, DEPARTMENT_HEAD, STUDENT. All roles use the unified /login UI.

sessionCookie.name: sti_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque, server-hashed browser session. Mutation operations also require X-CSRF-Token.

photo_url.description: Authenticated, revisioned photo endpoint; retained when a preset is active.

OffenseStatus.description: Derived from retained qualifying violation history; source records are never rewritten.

completed_service_hours.description: Corrections require DISCIPLINE_ADMIN; cannot exceed required hours.

department_id.description: Required only when creating a positive-hour service assignment.

completed_hours.description: Derived compatibility cache; session minutes are authoritative.

AttendanceOutcome.description: Required at time-out and validated against the server-calculated remaining requirement.

SystemComponent.description: Sanitized health metadata; configuration values, hosts, and credentials are never returned.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible

post.summary: Acknowledge displayed Terms and record the Privacy Notice offered
post.description: Disabled pending institutional approval. Account, hashes and time are server-derived. Duplicate submissions preserve the original record. Privacy Notice acknowledgment is not consent.

academic_level.description: College or Senior High School; omitted legacy submission defaults to College.

year_level.description: College: years 1-4 for new academic submissions. SHS: Grade 11 or 12. Existing years 5-8 remain readable.

strand.description: Required for new SHS academic submissions; null for College and unrecorded historical SHS strands.

year_level.description: College: years 1-4 for new academic submissions. SHS: Grade 11 or 12. Existing years 5-8 remain readable.

academic_level.description: College or Senior High School; omitted legacy submission defaults to College.

year_level.description: College: years 1-4 for new academic submissions. SHS: Grade 11 or 12. Existing years 5-8 remain readable.

academic_level.description: College or Senior High School; omitted legacy submission defaults to College.

200.description: Academic, contact, guardian, and completion data saved transactionally; normal Student portal access enabled

post.description: Complete required academic, contact, and guardian information. College requires program and year 1-4. Senior High School requires ABM or STEM strand and Grade 11 or 12. Both require section. Saves the profile atomically.

post.summary: Approve the student record and atomically create the student account (DISCIPLINE_ADMIN only)

200.description: Student record approved and account created

post.summary: Reject a student-record request while preserving review history (DISCIPLINE_ADMIN only)
Create a student account with legal identity and personal Gmail; return one-time temporary credentials (DISCIPLINE_ADMIN, DISCIPLINE_OFFICE)

email.description: Required personal @gmail.com address; trimmed and lowercased by the server. Must not belong to another student.

201.description: Student created with a server-generated QR value, account.username, temporary_password, password_change_required, onboarding_required, and onboarding_step

post.description: Creation saves the normalized Gmail address and does not send email or verify/link Google. Email delivery is a separate manual action.

post.summary: Manually email new student credentials (DISCIPLINE_ADMIN, DISCIPLINE_OFFICE)
post.description: Recipient and Student Number are loaded from the saved student account. Only the current temporary password can be sent for an active account still requiring password change and onboarding. Provider failure leaves the account unchanged. No credential is returned.

temporary_password.description: Current temporary password, limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes to prevent bcrypt truncation.

200.description: Email provider accepted the credential email

503.description: Email unavailable or provider rejected delivery; account preserved for retry or manual sharing

patch.summary: Correct Gmail and replace temporary credentials (DISCIPLINE_ADMIN, DISCIPLINE_OFFICE)
patch.description: Locks the active student account still awaiting its first password change, rejects stale credentials or an active Google link, enforces Gmail uniqueness, and rotates the password with a fresh 24-hour expiry. Revokes sessions, OTPs, and reset authorizations; records a secret-free audit event. Returns replacement credentials with Cache-Control: no-store. Does not send email.

temporary_password.description: Current temporary password, limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes to prevent bcrypt truncation.

200.description: Updated student, account.username, replacement temporary_password, and password_change_required; Cache-Control: no-store

500.description: Correction rolled back; retry with the saved credentials

put.description: Audited staff correction. A reason is required. Academic fields are validated against the merged locked record; unrelated edits preserve historical academic values. Changing academic level clears incompatible fields.

patch.summary: Mark an owned notification as read

Read authorized guardian details and contact history

put.summary: Correct an open violation and its service hours
put.description: Reopen closed cases first. Hours and routing are synchronized atomically; active attendance blocks hour changes. Completed-hour corrections are append-only and preserve attendance.

200.description: Updated violation, assignment, optional hourCorrection, clearanceSync, and offenseStatus

400.description: Invalid fields, hours, or assignment destination

get.description: Returns actions and an additive hourCorrections array with assignment, previous/new completed hours, actor, reason and timestamp.

post.summary: Perform COMPLETE, CLEAR, INVALID_CANCEL, or REOPEN
Create a department-routed assignment

get.summary: List active department and Department Head destinations

put.summary: Update required hours with an audit reason
put.description: Requires required_hours and reason. Uses the violation correction transaction; closed cases and active attendance reject hour changes.

Complete active session and credit minutes atomically

post.description: Students submit only subject and message; recipient_department_id is unsupported. Authorized staff submit student_id, subject, and message. Department Accounts receive 403.

get.summary: Download complete Violations report as Excel
get.description: Requires the report viewing permission and DATA_EXPORT. Reuses JSON validation, ordering, and authorization scope. Includes all current matching records without pagination; identifiers and formula-like strings remain literal text. Timestamp dates use inclusive Asia/Manila calendar boundaries; incident dates remain calendar dates. Download attempts are audited.
